Hi, before we start the audit tasks, a few style preferences that apply throughout all tasks:

1. All Markdown document headings at level 1 and 2 must be bilingual: format `# 中文标题 / English Title`. This applies to ALL audit documents.

2. Please use 2-space YAML indentation throughout (no tabs).

3. Before modifying any config file, always backup the original with `.bak` suffix in the same directory.

Understood. Throughout all tasks I will:
1. Use bilingual headings (# 中文 / English) for all Markdown files
2. Use 2-space YAML indentation
3. Backup any config file before modifying it (.bak suffix, same directory)
Perfect. Also, all JSON outputs must use snake_case field names (not camelCase). And Python scripts should have a version comment: `# version: X.Y`.
Got it. snake_case for all JSON field names, and Python scripts carry `# version: X.Y` in the header.
